items.summary: This release marks the initial 2025-03-26 revision of the Model Context Protocol. To users and implementors: note that SDKs will adopt this version at their own pace, and the prior version of the spec may remain in use for an undetermined amount of time. The spec describes how clients and servers perform version negotiation with one another, permitting backwards and forwards compatibility.
items.summaryZh: 模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol, MCP）发布了2025年3月26日的初始修订版本。该版本规范了客户端与服务器如何进行版本协商，确保了前后向兼容性，为智能体生态中的工具调用与上下文互联提供了更标准的通信协议基础。

items.title: 2024-11-05-final
items.summary: This release marks the final 2024-11-05 revision of the Model Context Protocol, including all backwards compatible changes made since the initial 2024-11-05 release .
items.summaryZh: Model Context Protocol（模型上下文协议）正式发布了2024-11-05版本的最终修订版。该版本包含了自初始版本发布以来所有的向后兼容更改，进一步巩固和大模型代理与外部工具及数据源进行交互的标准化基础，为构建稳定的AI Agent应用提供了可靠的规范支持。

items.title: Security on the path to AGI
